subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should Browserbase session lifecycle be supported as first-party browser plugin behavior now, routed through a generic browser-backend/plugin seam first, or handled as a docs correction until maintainers approve the commercial-service integration boundary?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses commercial-service integration policy, browser-control security, credential storage, signed URL redaction, config/schema/API surface, and session lifecycle ownership, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Revise the Browserbase driver path
options.body: Accept first-party Browserbase support only after credential contract, redaction, route coverage, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

options.title: Design the generic backend seam first
options.body: Keep this issue tied to the broader browser backend/plugin API so Browserbase can ship outside core once the registration contract exists.

options.title: Document the limitation
options.body: Remove or narrow the static Browserbase setup docs until maintainers are ready to support Sessions API lifecycle in product code.

recommendation.title: Revise the Browserbase driver path
recommendation.body: Accept first-party Browserbase support only after credential contract, redaction, route coverage, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal across the browser plugin boundary, CDP attach behavior, and docs/runtime rewrite touched by this decision.
